entries.title: Heel-Shafted Mallet Golf Putter
entries.description: One original static golf-putter appearance: a broad bevelled flat-soled metal mallet head, a slim heel-offset leaning shaft and a thicker dark upper grip. Three closed connected component meshes and three opaque untextured PBR materials, one prop and zero scenes. The shaft lower flat cap is entirely seated on the head top; the grip lower cap covers the shaft top with a finite opposed seat. All numeric geometry is new, not a hockey toe blade, baseball bat or old handle transplant. Metres, Z up, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. Static game-art display, not regulation golf dimensions, real playability, grip suitability, balance, material performance or safety certification. No ball, turf, golfer, text, logo, animation or physical operation.

entries.title: Interlaced Wattle Hurdle
entries.description: One newly authored static low-poly wattle fence hurdle: nine independent continuous rounded branches weave alternately in front of and behind three complete upright stakes. Neighbouring branch rows use opposite weave phase, with real three-dimensional routing rather than flat crossed strips or texture. Three opaque constant wood PBR materials. Separate closed editable components, no reused prior fence or basket mesh. Horizontal whole-bounds centre and flat stake soles at Z0. Visual interlacing only: not simulated weaving, motion, growth, fencing effectiveness, structural load, stability, safety or fabrication guidance.

entries.title: Bound Bamboo Panflute
entries.description: One original static bamboo-style panflute gift: seven separately editable graduated stopped-bottom pipes with real open top mouths, full inner walls and blind floors, bound into one complete instrument by two continuous flat bands. All mouths align at one upper playing edge while the bottoms form the familiar graded panpipe silhouette. Nine closed meshes and two opaque matte solid PBR roles. Newly authored whole profiles and layout, not extracted plumbing, a gouge, fluted column or a variation of an existing panflute. Small intentional hidden band-to-pipe overlaps represent fixed bindings; no braiding, motion, acoustic tuning, pitch range, playability, manufacturing, safety or physical stability claim. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal bounds centred, longest pipe ground face at Z0. One static prop, not seven separately counted assets.

entries.title: Four-Direction Sloped-Pocket Magazine Rack
entries.description: One original freestanding static magazine-display fixture for a newsstand or convenience shop. An integral low square base, central post and eight short radial arms support four separate open sloped-mouth pockets, one facing each cardinal direction. Each pocket has a complete closed floor, tall rear wall, low front lip, sloped side walls and a genuine empty chamber open above. The adjacent pockets are separated, not intersecting cross-shaped boxes; each has two full rectangular rear seats. Five closed editable meshes, two opaque untextured PBR materials. No papers, labels, rotating joint, bearings, contents, working motion, load or tipping stability, manufacture or safety capability is claimed. Metres, Z up, front -Y, centred grounded origin. Newly authored whole stand, not a detached copy of the existing kiosk side rack or a recoloured book cart.

entries.description: Original static wheelchair appearance with two large open annular rear tires, metal rims and eight spokes per wheel, two small front casters, tubular side frames and push handles, upholstered seat/back, arm supports and separated footplates. New whole geometry, not a bicycle or goods trolley import. Static visual prop only: no person, animation, operable wheels, brakes, load capacity, human-fit, mobility, medical, accessibility, manufacturing, installation or safety performance is claimed.

entries.title: Static Axillary Crutch
entries.description: Original single static axillary crutch appearance: two converging tube rails support a concave padded top rest and a transverse cushioned grip; one lower stem terminates in a closed flared rubber foot. No person, articulation, height adjustment, medical use, human fit, load capacity, stability, manufacture or safety performance is claimed.

entries.title: Static Spiral-Shell Snail
entries.description: One original static stylised snail with a continuous elongated broad flat-foot body, raised front head, tapered rear tail, two long tapered eye stalks, two small dark eyes and two shorter lower feelers. The complete solid external shell has real shallow spiral height relief on both sides, with warm matte material bands following the geometric ridges. Eight newly authored closed editable meshes and four constant opaque PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontal full-bounds-centred ground origin. One prop and zero scenes; shell, stalks and eyes are never counted as separate assets. Different whole gastropod appearance, not a tortoise with feet deleted, copied octopus body or coral branches. No hollow biological shell, species-level anatomy, locomotion, growth, ecology, softness, rig, animation, collision or real animal performance claim.
